meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Haan — **dark spots + dull skin** ke liye main beginner ke liye **10% Vitamin C** se start karunga. India mein meri shortlist:

### [Minimalist 16% Vitamin C + E + Ferulic Acid]()
*₹569.10*

### [Deconstruct Vitamin C Serum]()
*₹457*

### [Dot & Key Vitamin C + E + Niacinamide Serum]()
*₹278*

### [Plum 15% Vitamin C Serum]()
*₹457*

**Meri pick:** 🥇 **Deconstruct 10% Vitamin C** — agar aap pehli baar Vitamin C use kar rahe ho. Isme 10% liposomal Vitamin C + 0.5% ferulic acid hai aur formula relatively beginner-friendly hai. [thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/shop/products/vitamin-c-and-ferulic-acid-serum?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Agar dark spots zyada prominent hain:** Dot & Key ka **10% Vitamin C + 5% Niacinamide** bhi achha option hai; brand specifically pigmentation/dark spots aur dullness ko target karta hai. [www.dotandkey.com](https://www.dotandkey.com/collections/vitamin-c-skin-care/products/dot-key-10-vitamin-c-e-5-niacinamide-serum-for-glowing-skin-beginner-friendly?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Use kaise karein:** subah cleanser → 2–3 drops serum → moisturizer → **SPF 50 sunscreen**. Pehle 2–3 din/week start karke tolerance ke hisaab se daily kar sakte ho. Sunscreen bahut important hai—warna dark spots wapas/darker ho sakte hain. [thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/products/15-vitamin-c-serum-with-liposomal-technology?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar aap mujhe **apni skin type (oily/dry/combination/sensitive) + budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000)** bata do, main **ek exact serum** choose kar dunga.
